interpretation.shared_interface_repair: Pending Birth and valid anonymous current measurements are common state/evidence repair, not ordinal depth increment.
interpretation.mixed_quality_increment: MIXED_ORDER minus ACTIVITY_ORDER includes qualification-induced lifetime/candidate effects; isolate whole sequence rather than one selected frame.
interpretation.ordinal_increment: MIXED_ORDER minus MIXED_OFF holds state/interface and mixed qualification fixed.
interpretation.publication: applied_at_first_publication on automatic audit means published in that decision frame. Actual first-ever source publication remains independently in Birth metadata.
interpretation.pending: snapshot evaluation_frame is not retry time; last_evaluation_frame is the last held/UNKNOWN evaluation that updated the cached record via remember_birth, not necessarily the most recent attempted retry. The source-cache prose calling it the most recent evaluation is superseded by this control-flow correction. Alias/past-window cached PENDING records are dormant, not counted as live eligible proposals.
interpretation.reference: Actual bank physical agreement and inherited public-origin mismatch remain separate; conservative physical WRONG can coexist with actual_reference_physical CORRECT.
interpretation.initial_candidate_order_boundary: On first proposal frame, a later matrix candidate can see a pending record before its initial target is registered and be marked PENDING_TARGET_ANCHOR_CHANGED. It is registered later that same frame; this is metadata/qualification ordering, not evidence of measured conflict. LW3064 also has independent whole UNKNOWN failures, so no causal performance effect is asserted.
